Signup.title: Create your account
Signup.description: Register to use WEEAIM. After you verify your email, an administrator reviews your request.
Signup.passwordHint: At least {count} characters. A short phrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
Signup.accessReason: How do you plan to use WEEAIM?
Signup.accessReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Validate my startup idea for the entrepreneurship course.

consents.accept_terms: I agree to the WEEAIM Terms of Use.
consents.accept_privacy: I consent to the collection and use of my personal information as described below.
consents.accept_ai_processing: I understand that the ideas, answers and documents I submit are processed by an external AI service (OpenAI) to produce analyses.

Signup.privacyCollected: We collect your name, email, affiliation, school or organization, department, preferred language and planned use. Your password is stored only as a one-way hash.
Signup.privacyPurpose: We use it to create and secure your account, to let administrators review your access request, and to contact you about your account.
Signup.privacyAi: Content you submit for analysis is sent to OpenAI. Don't submit information you aren't allowed to share.
Signup.privacyRetention: We keep it while your account exists. You can ask an administrator to delete your account and data at any time.
Signup.verifyDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it below to verify your address.
Signup.errorPasswordContainsEmail: Your password shouldn't contain your email address.
Signup.errorAffiliationName: Please enter your school or organization.
Signup.errorAccessReason: Please tell us a little more (at least 10 characters).
Signup.errorConsentRequired: This agreement is required to create an account.
Signup.errorInvalid: Some details weren't accepted. Please check the form and try again.

VerifyEmail.title: Verify your email
VerifyEmail.description: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you when you signed up, along with your password.
VerifyEmail.resent: If this account still needs verifying, a new code is on its way. Check your spam folder too.
VerifyEmail.errorCodeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
VerifyEmail.errorInvalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired, or the password doesn't match. Check the latest email, or send a new code.
VerifyEmail.awaitingBody: Your account is now awaiting administrator approval. We'll email you as soon as it's approved, and then you can sign in.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a 6-digit reset code.
ForgotPassword.resetDescription: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent it a 6-digit code. Enter it with your new password.
ForgotPassword.doneDescription: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with it.
ForgotPassword.errorCodeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
ForgotPassword.errorInvalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest email, or start over to get a new code.
